heading: Today
text: A few patches of fog early. Sunshine, mixing with clouds. A few scattered showers or thunderstorms developing through NY in the afternoon, isolated through VT, NH, into MA and Quebec. Highs in the low to mid 80s, a few 70s in the Adirondacks. Winds light, becoming south less than 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Localized evening showers or a thunderstorm, tapering off. Becoming partly cloudy, with a few patches of fog. Lows in the upper 50s to low 60s, some mid 60s near Lake Champlain. Winds light and variable, continuing from the south near 10 mph near Lake Champlain, a few gusts to 20 mph.

heading: Tuesday
text: A few patches of fog early, morning sun giving way to clouds. Scattered showers or thunderstorms increasing through NY into southwest VT and the Berkshires, spreading northeast in the afternoon. Highs in the 70s to around 80. Winds becoming south to southeast near 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph through the Champlain Valley.
